name: Arai Rio
source:
A classmate of Kazuto's and the manager of the boxing club. She often jokingly argues with him. While her personality is unrefined and unyielding, she actually has an incredibly girlish crush on Kazuto.

[translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=16356]Getchu[/url]]
